```r
plot_normalized_score <- function(df, image_path, has_secondary_marker = TRUE) {
  # score_col/label_y come from the GUI's score-type toggle (scoreType/useBZ,
  # set once near the top of the pipeline) -- independent of signal ON/OFF.
  label_y <- if (useBZ) "BZ-Score" else "Z-Score"

  # --- Guard against the empty-plot failure mode ---
  # If score_col is entirely NA (e.g. BZScore never populated for this run) or
  # contains Inf/-Inf (zero-variance plate in the MAD/SD normalization step),
  # both the >=3 and <3 filters below can silently return zero rows, or the
  # y-axis range becomes non-finite -- either way you get axes with nothing
  # plotted and no error. Drop non-finite scores up front and warn loudly
  # instead of failing silently.
  n_total       <- nrow(df)
  n_nonfinite   <- sum(!is.finite(df[[score_col]]))
  if (n_nonfinite > 0) {
    warning(n_nonfinite, " of ", n_total, " wells have non-finite ", score_col,
            " (NA/Inf) and are being dropped from the normalized score plot.")
  }
  df <- df %>% filter(is.finite(.data[[score_col]]))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    stop("plot_normalized_score(): no wells have a finite ", score_col,
         " value -- check upstream normalization before plotting.")
  }

  y_limits <- c(min(df[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE), max(df[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE))
  y_breaks <- c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4, 6, 8)

  hits_df <- dplyr::filter(df, .data[[score_col]] >= 3)
  bg_df   <- dplyr::filter(df, .data[[score_col]] < 3)

  if (has_secondary_marker) {
    hits_df <- hits_df %>% mutate(pass = as.character(secondary_marker_ok & viab_ok))
  } else {
    # No secondary marker channel: secondary_marker_ok defaults to TRUE (set above), but viability
    # still matters, so a hit only passes if it clears the viability bar.
    hits_df <- hits_df %>% mutate(pass = as.character(viab_ok))
  }

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = paste0(Well, Plate), y = .data[[score_col]])) +
    geom_point(
      data     = bg_df,
      color    = "gray70",
      size     = 0.5,
      alpha    = 0.375,  # 25% darker than the previous 0.3
      position = position_jitter(width = 0.3, height = 0)
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data  = hits_df,
      aes(color = pass, size = pass),
      alpha = 1
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = hits_df,
      aes(label = Reference),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.3,
      point.padding = 0.2,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black")) +
    scale_size_manual(values  = c("TRUE" = 1.6,   "FALSE" = 1.2)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.5) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(x = "Compound", y = label_y) +
    guides(color = "none", size = "none")

  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(image_path, "normalized_SigScoreSecondaryMarkerScreen.pdf"),
    plot     = p,
    dpi      = 300,
    width    = 8,
    height   = 8
  )

  return(p)
}
plot_normalized_score(merged_df, image_Save_Location, has_secondary_marker = has_secondary_marker)
```

```r
#DISTRIBUTION PLOTS
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
#RAW DISTRIBUTION
# Create histogram of raw foci per cell
  raw_distribution <- ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = AvgFoci)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "darkgray", binwidth = 1) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "darkgray") +
    labs(title = NULL, y = "Count", x = "MLF2-GFP Foci/Cell") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.2))
  
 
ggsave(paste(image_Save_Location, "RawFociDistribution.pdf", sep = ""),
        raw_distribution,
        dpi = 300,
        width = 12,
        height = 12)
 

 
#NORMALIZED EFFECT DISTRIBUTION
  normalized_dist <- ggplot(merged_df, aes(x = PercentEffect)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "darkgray", binwidth = 4 ) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "darkgray") +
    # Add reference lines and labels
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 100), linetype = 'dashed', size = 2.5) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), linetype = 'dashed', size = 2.5) +
    theme_classic() +
    # Allow the rotated control-name labels (e.g. "DMSO") to draw past the
    # panel edge instead of being clipped to "MSO"/etc.
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme(title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm"),
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.2),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 10, l = 30))
 
 
#Normalized Distribution Plot:
# Place the WT/DMSO control labels at half the tallest bin's height so they
# sit roughly mid-plot regardless of how many wells/bins this run has.
.hist_max <- max(
  hist(merged_df$PercentEffect, breaks = seq(min(merged_df$PercentEffect, na.rm = TRUE),
                                              max(merged_df$PercentEffect, na.rm = TRUE) + 4,
                                              by = 4),
       plot = FALSE)$counts
)
.label_y <- .hist_max / 2
 
if (assayType == "OFF") {
normalized_dist <- normalized_dist +
  annotate("text", x = 90, y = .label_y, label = pos_Ctrl, angle = 90, size = 16) +
  annotate("text", x = -15, y = .label_y, label = neg_Ctrl, color = "black", angle = 90, size = 16) +
  labs(title = NULL, y = "Count", x = "% Decrease in Foci")
 } else {
normalized_dist <- normalized_dist +
  annotate("text", x = 90, y = .label_y, label = pos_Ctrl, angle = 90, size = 14) +
  annotate("text", x = -20, y = .label_y, label = neg_Ctrl, color = "black", angle = 90, size = 14) +
  labs(title = NULL, y = "Count", x = "% Increase in Foci")
 } 
     
  # Save distribution plots
  ggsave(paste(image_Save_Location, "NormalizedEffectDistribution.pdf", sep = ""),
        normalized_dist,
        dpi = 300,
        width = 12,
        height = 12)
 

# ── NEW DYNAMIC DISTRIBUTIONS (per condition / well) ─────────────────────────
# Each plot is drawn only if its column exists in merged_df and has data, so a
# missing optional channel is silently skipped instead of erroring. merged_df is
# one row per condition/well, matching the existing raw/normalized distributions.
.distr_theme <- theme_classic() +
  theme(title        = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 36, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.4, "cm"),
        axis.ticks   = element_line(size = 1.2))
 
# (1) Cytoplasmic GFP foci COUNT distribution
if ("CytoFoci_Count" %in% names(merged_df) && any(!is.na(merged_df$CytoFoci_Count))) {
  cyto_foci_dist <- ggplot(subset(merged_df, !is.na(CytoFoci_Count)),
                           aes(x = CytoFoci_Count)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "darkgray", bins = 30) +
    labs(title = NULL, y = "Count (conditions)", x = "Cytoplasmic GFP Foci / Cell") +
    .distr_theme
  ggsave(paste(image_Save_Location, "CytoFociCount_distribution.pdf", sep = ""),
         cyto_foci_dist, dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 12)
  print(cyto_foci_dist)
} else {
  message("Skipping cytoplasmic-foci-count distribution: column absent or all-NA.")
}
 
# (2) Nuclear GFP foci INTEGRATED INTENSITY distribution
if ("NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity" %in% names(merged_df) && any(!is.na(merged_df$NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity))) {
  nuc_foci_int_dist <- ggplot(subset(merged_df, !is.na(NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity)),
                              aes(x = NucFoci_IntegratedIntensity)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "darkgray", bins = 30) +
    labs(title = NULL, y = "Count (conditions)", x = "Nuclear GFP Foci Integrated Intensity") +
    .distr_theme
  ggsave(paste(image_Save_Location, "NucFociIntInt_distribution.pdf", sep = ""),
         nuc_foci_int_dist, dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 12)
   
} else {
  message("Skipping nuclear-foci integrated-intensity distribution: column absent or all-NA.")
}
 
# (3) secondary marker normalized effect distribution (only if a secondary marker channel exists)
if (has_secondary_marker && "SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff" %in% names(merged_df) && any(!is.na(merged_df$SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff))) {
  secondary_marker_dist_df <- merged_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff)) %>%
    mutate(TotalPercentSecondaryMarker = 100 + SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff)
 
  SecondaryMarker_dist <- ggplot(secondary_marker_dist_df, aes(x = TotalPercentSecondaryMarker)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "darkgray", binwidth = 4) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.6, fill = "darkgray") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 100), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 2.5) +
    labs(title = NULL, y = "Count (conditions)", x = "secondary marker % of plate mean") +
    .distr_theme
 
  ggsave(paste(image_Save_Location, "SecondaryMarker_NormalizedEffect_distribution.pdf", sep = ""),
         SecondaryMarker_dist, dpi = 300, width = 12, height = 12)
   
} else {
  message("Skipping secondary marker normalized-effect distribution: no secondary marker channel.")
}
```

```r
###OPTIONAL###
 
# ============================================================
# HTS Spatial QC - Global Row/Col MEDIAN shifts + Heatmaps
# Refactored for improved readability and logical flow
# ============================================================
 
# ============================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================
#If not previously defined:
#fileX   <- paste0(project_data_dir, "CondenScreenV2.xlsx")
 
fileX            <- paste0(file_Location, "CondenScreenV2.xlsx")
sheetX           <- "Combined Analysis"
out_dir          <- paste0(file_Location, "HTS_QC_OUT/")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
#Update this value based on the Z-Score or BZ-Score threshold you are using for hit selection. 
#If hit_threshold <- 2, then any well positions that are called as hits if Z or BZ-Score >= 2. 
hit_threshold <- 2
#QC threshold to identify significant row/col shifts in hit frequency (chi-square test) or score distribution.
alpha_qc <- 0.05
well_fold_threshold <- 3   # flag well positions hit >= Nx the mean recurrence rate
score_outlier_sd <- 3      # flag cols/rows whose median BZScore is >n SDs from mean of medians
 
# ============================================================
# 2. HELPERS
# ============================================================
save_plot <- function(p, fname, w=12, h=6)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, fname), plot=p, width=w, height=h, dpi=300)
 
theme_prismish <- function(base_size=12)
  theme_classic(base_size=base_size) +
  theme(plot.title   = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face="bold", size=16),
        axis.text.x  = element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(face="bold", size=14),
        panel.grid   = element_blank())
 
bar_shift <- function(df_sum, xcol, ycol, title, xlab, ylab, rotate_x=FALSE, ylim=NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df_sum, aes(x=.data[[xcol]], y=.data[[ycol]])) +
    geom_col(fill="#2E1A47", color="black", linewidth=0.25, width=0.9) +
    geom_hline(yintercept=0, linetype="dashed", linewidth=0.4) +
    labs(title=title, x=xlab, y=ylab) + theme_prismish()
  if (!is.null(ylim))  p <- p + coord_cartesian(ylim=ylim)
  if (rotate_x)        p <- p + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1))
  p
}
 
heatmap_metric <- function(df_grid, fill_col, title, fill_lab)
  ggplot(df_grid, aes(x=factor(col2), y=row, fill=.data[[fill_col]])) +
  geom_tile(color=NA) +
  labs(title=title, x="Column", y="Row", fill=fill_lab) +
  theme_prismish() +
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5), legend.position="right") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option="viridis", na.value="grey90") +
  guides(fill=guide_colorbar(title.position="top", barwidth=unit(0.5,"cm"), barheight=unit(6,"cm")))
 
parse_well <- function(df)
  df %>% mutate(row=str_sub(Well,1,1), col=as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]")),
                col2=sprintf("%02d",col), well_pos=paste0(row,col2))
 
chisq_hit_test <- function(df, group_var, hit_col="Hit") {
  counts <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarize(n=n(), hits=sum(.data[[hit_col]]==1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(hit_rate=hits/n)
  ct <- chisq.test(counts$hits, p=counts$n/sum(counts$n))
  counts %>% mutate(std_resid=as.numeric(ct$stdres), global_p=ct$p.value,
                    flagged=global_p < alpha_qc & abs(std_resid) > 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(std_resid)))
}
 
chisq_score_shift <- function(df, group_var, score_col=NULL, n_sd=score_outlier_sd) {
  if (is.null(score_col)) stop("score_col must be specified, e.g. 'BZScore' or 'ZScore'")
  grp_medians <- df %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
    summarize(n=n(), med=median(.data[[score_col]], na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
  global_mean <- mean(grp_medians$med, na.rm=TRUE)
  global_sd   <- sd(grp_medians$med,   na.rm=TRUE)
  grp_medians %>%
    mutate(
      z_of_median = (med - global_mean) / global_sd,
      flagged     = abs(z_of_median) > n_sd,
      direction   = case_when(
        z_of_median >  n_sd ~ "enriched",
        z_of_median < -n_sd ~ "suppressed",
        TRUE                ~ "normal"
      )
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(z_of_median)))
}
 
# Fold-over-mean recurrence  
well_recurrence_test <- function(df, hit_col="Hit", fold_threshold=well_fold_threshold) {
  n_pl <- n_distinct(df$Plate)
  recurrence <- df %>% filter(.data[[hit_col]]==1) %>%
    group_by(well_pos) %>%
    summarize(n_plates_as_hit=n_distinct(Plate), hit_rate=n_plates_as_hit/n_pl,
              plates=paste(sort(unique(Plate)), collapse=", "), .groups="drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(n_plates_as_hit))
  mean_recurrence <- mean(recurrence$n_plates_as_hit)
  threshold       <- mean_recurrence * fold_threshold
  cat("Well recurrence: mean =", round(mean_recurrence,2),
      "| fold threshold =", fold_threshold,
      "| flagging wells with >=", round(threshold,2), "plates\n")
  recurrence %>% mutate(
    mean_recurrence = mean_recurrence,
    fold_over_mean  = n_plates_as_hit / mean_recurrence,
    flagged         = n_plates_as_hit >= threshold
  )
}
 
plot_plate_hits <- function(df, hit_col="Hit", sig_plates=character(0), title="Hits: global plate totals") {
  plate_sum <- df %>% group_by(Plate) %>%
    summarize(hit_sum=sum(.data[[hit_col]]==1, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(sig=Plate %in% sig_plates)
  
  ggplot(plate_sum, aes(x=factor(Plate), y=hit_sum)) +
    geom_col(fill="#2E1A47", color="black", linewidth=0.25, width=0.9) +
    geom_text(aes(label=hit_sum), vjust=-0.35, size=3) +
    geom_text(data=subset(plate_sum,sig), aes(label="*"), vjust=-1.2, size=6) +
    labs(title=title, x="Plate", y="Total hits") + theme_prismish() +
    theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5, hjust=1))
}
 
paper_div_impact_clean <- function(lims=c(-2,2), midpoint=0)
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=c("#E00000","#FF7A00","#FFFFFF","#5A0AA4","#1A0033"),
    values=scales::rescale(c(lims[1], lims[1]+(midpoint-lims[1])*0.5, midpoint,
                             midpoint+(lims[2]-midpoint)*0.5, lims[2]), from=lims),
    limits=lims, oob=scales::squish)
 
hit_impact_purple_deeper <- function(max_hits, zero_color="#F5F5F5")
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours=c(zero_color,"#B8AEC9","#5A3E86","#4A3A73","#1A0033"),
    values=scales::rescale(c(0, max_hits*0.3, max_hits*0.55, max_hits*0.8, max_hits),
                           from=c(0,max_hits)),
    limits=c(0,max_hits), oob=scales::squish,
    guide=guide_colorbar(title="Hits per well", barheight=unit(5,"cm")))
 
heatmap_theme_clean <- theme(
  plot.title=element_text(size=16, face="bold", hjust=0),
  axis.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
  axis.text.x=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  axis.text.y=element_text(size=12, face="bold"),
  legend.title=element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
  legend.text=element_text(size=12, face="bold"))
 
# ============================================================
# 3. LOAD & PREP
# ============================================================
df <- read.xlsx(fileX, sheet=sheetX) %>% parse_well()
if (!("BZScore" %in% colnames(df))) df$BZScore <- NA_real_
has_bz <- any(!is.na(df$BZScore))
 
df <- df %>% mutate(
  Hit  = if ("Hit" %in% colnames(.)) as.integer(Hit)
         else if (has_bz) as.integer(BZScore >= hit_threshold)
         else as.integer(ZScore >= hit_threshold),
  row      = factor(str_sub(Well,1,1) %>% {factor(., levels=sort(unique(.)))}),
  col2     = factor(sprintf("%02d", as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]"))),
                    levels=sprintf("%02d", sort(unique(as.integer(str_remove(Well,"^[A-Za-z]")))))),
  well_pos = factor(well_pos)
)
 
score_metric <- if ("Hit" %in% colnames(df)) "Hit (precomputed)" else if (has_bz) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
score_col    <- if (has_bz) "BZScore" else "ZScore"
 
# ============================================================
# 4. SUMMARIES
# ============================================================
summarize_by <- function(df, grp, ...) df %>% group_by(.data[[grp]]) %>% summarize(..., .groups="drop")
 
row_z  <- summarize_by(df,"row",  med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
row_bz <- summarize_by(df,"row",  med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
row_h  <- summarize_by(df,"row",  hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE))
col_z  <- summarize_by(df,"col2", med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
col_bz <- summarize_by(df,"col2", med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE))
col_h  <- summarize_by(df,"col2", hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE))
 
grid_sum <- df %>% group_by(row,col2) %>%
  summarize(med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
 
plate_row_stats <- df %>% group_by(Plate,row) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
plate_col_stats <- df %>% group_by(Plate,col2) %>%
  summarize(n=n(), med_z=median(ZScore,na.rm=TRUE), med_bz=median(BZScore,na.rm=TRUE),
            hit_sum=sum(Hit,na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop")
 
# ============================================================
# 5. TESTS
# ============================================================
test_row_hit         <- chisq_hit_test(df,"row")
test_col_hit         <- chisq_hit_test(df,"col2")
test_plate_hit       <- chisq_hit_test(df, "Plate")
 
test_well_recurrence <- well_recurrence_test(df, fold_threshold=well_fold_threshold)
```

```r
sig_rows_hit     <- test_row_hit         %>% filter(flagged) %>% pull(row)      %>% as.character()
```

```r
# ============================================================
# 6. PLOTS
# ============================================================
lim_val  <- function(x) { v <- max(abs(x), na.rm=TRUE); ifelse(is.finite(v) && v>0, v, 1) }
ylim_row <- c(-1,1) * lim_val(c(row_z$med_z, row_bz$med_bz))
ylim_col <- c(-1,1) * lim_val(c(col_z$med_z, col_bz$med_bz))
 
p_row_z <- bar_shift(row_z,  "row",  "med_z",   "ZScore: global row shift (median)",  "Row",    "Median ZScore",  ylim=ylim_row)
p_row_h <- bar_shift(row_h,  "row",  "hit_sum", "Hits: global row totals",             "Row",    "Total hits")
p_col_z <- bar_shift(col_z,  "col2", "med_z",   "ZScore: global col shift (median)",  "Column", "Median ZScore",  rotate_x=TRUE, ylim=ylim_col)
p_col_h <- bar_shift(col_h,  "col2", "hit_sum", "Hits: global col totals",             "Column", "Total hits",     rotate_x=TRUE)
if (has_bz) {
  p_row_bz <- bar_shift(row_bz, "row",  "med_bz", "BZScore: global row shift (median)", "Row",    "Median BZScore", ylim=ylim_row)
  p_col_bz <- bar_shift(col_bz, "col2", "med_bz", "BZScore: global col shift (median)", "Column", "Median BZScore", rotate_x=TRUE, ylim=ylim_col)
}
 
p_heat_z   <- heatmap_metric(grid_sum,"med_z",  "Heatmap: Median Z-Score by Well Position",   "Median Z-Score")  + paper_div_impact_clean() + heatmap_theme_clean + scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)
p_heat_hit <- heatmap_metric(grid_sum,"hit_sum","Heatmap: Total Hits by Well Position",        "Total hits")      + hit_impact_purple_deeper(max(grid_sum$hit_sum,na.rm=TRUE)) + heatmap_theme_clean + scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)
if (has_bz)
  p_heat_bz <- heatmap_metric(grid_sum,"med_bz","Heatmap: Median BZ-Score by Well Position",  "Median BZ-Score") + paper_div_impact_clean() + heatmap_theme_clean + scale_y_discrete(limits=rev)
 
p_plate_h <- plot_plate_hits(df, sig_plates=sig_plates_hit,
                             title="Hits: global plate totals (significant plates marked *)")
h_rc <- if (has_bz) 12 else 9
 
row_fig <- {
  if (has_bz) (p_row_z/p_row_bz/p_row_h) + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1,1))
  else        (p_row_z/p_row_h)           + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1))
} + plot_annotation(title="Global Row QC")
 
col_fig <- {
  if (has_bz) (p_col_z/p_col_bz/p_col_h) + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1,1))
  else        (p_col_z/p_col_h)           + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1))
} + plot_annotation(title="Global Column QC")
 
heat_fig <- {
  if (has_bz) (p_heat_z/p_heat_bz/p_heat_hit) + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1,1))
  else        (p_heat_z/p_heat_hit)             + plot_layout(heights=c(1,1))
}
 
save_plot(row_fig,   "QC_ROWS_combined.png",  w=14, h=h_rc)
save_plot(col_fig,   "QC_COLS_combined.png",  w=14, h=h_rc)
save_plot(heat_fig,  "QC_HEAT_combined.png",  w=12, h=if(has_bz) 12 else 9)
save_plot(p_plate_h, "QC_PLATES_hits.png",    w=14, h=7)
 
# ============================================================
# 7. QC ANNOTATION
# ============================================================
type_string <- function(pl, r, c, wp) {
  out <- character(0)
  if (!is.na(r)  && as.character(r)  %in% sig_rows_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Row enrichment [Chi-sq]")
  if (!is.na(r)  && as.character(r)  %in% sig_rows_score)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Row score ", row_direction[as.character(r)], " [BZScore outlier]"))
  if (!is.na(c)  && as.character(c)  %in% sig_cols_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Col enrichment [Chi-sq]")
  if (!is.na(c)  && as.character(c)  %in% sig_cols_score)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Col score ", col_direction[as.character(c)], " [BZScore outlier]"))
  if (!is.na(wp) && as.character(wp) %in% recurrent_wells)
    out <- c(out, paste0("Well recurrence [>=", well_fold_threshold, "x mean]"))
  if (!is.na(pl) && as.character(pl) %in% sig_plates_hit)
    out <- c(out, "Plate enrichment [Hit]")
  if (length(out)==0) return("None")
  paste(unique(out), collapse="; ")
}
 
hits_df_qc <- df %>% filter(Hit==1) %>%
  mutate(Type_of_Error    = purrr::pmap_chr(list(Plate,row,col2,well_pos), type_string),
         Systematic_error = ifelse(Type_of_Error=="None","No","Yes"),
         QC_alpha         = alpha_qc,
         QC_well_fold_threshold = well_fold_threshold,
         QC_score_outlier_sd   = score_outlier_sd) %>%
  select(everything(), Systematic_error, Type_of_Error,
         QC_alpha, QC_well_fold_threshold, QC_score_outlier_sd) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("Hit","QC_row_score","QC_col_score","QC_well_score","QC_row_hit","QC_col_hit",
                   "QC_well_hit","QC_score_flag","QC_hit_flag","Systematic_plate_error",
                   "Systematic_error_type","QC_score_metric_used")))
 
# ============================================================
# 8. EXPORT
# ============================================================
orig_wb <- loadWorkbook(fileX)
if ("Hits_QC" %in% names(orig_wb)) removeWorksheet(orig_wb, "Hits_QC")
addWorksheet(orig_wb, "Hits_QC")
hits_out <- hits_df_qc %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
writeData(orig_wb, "Hits_QC", hits_out)
freezePane(orig_wb, "Hits_QC", firstRow=TRUE)
addFilter(orig_wb,  "Hits_QC", rows=1, cols=1:ncol(hits_out))
saveWorkbook(orig_wb, fileX, overwrite=TRUE)
 
wb <- createWorkbook()
write_df <- function(s, x) { addWorksheet(wb,s); writeData(wb,s,x) }
 
write_df("HITS_with_QC_flags",         hits_df_qc)
write_df("TEST_plate_chisq_hit",       test_plate_hit)
write_df("TEST_row_chisq_hit",         test_row_hit)
write_df("TEST_col_chisq_hit",         test_col_hit)
write_df("TEST_col_score_shift",       test_col_score_shift)
write_df("TEST_row_score_shift",       test_row_score_shift)
write_df("TEST_well_recurrence",       test_well_recurrence)
write_df("global_row_medians",  left_join(row_z,row_bz,by="row")  %>% left_join(row_h, by="row"))
write_df("global_col_medians",  left_join(col_z,col_bz,by="col2") %>% left_join(col_h, by="col2"))
write_df("global_grid",         grid_sum)
write_df("plate_row_stats",     plate_row_stats)
write_df("plate_col_stats",     plate_col_stats)
 
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(out_dir,"HTS_QC_RESULTS.xlsx"), overwrite=TRUE)
invisible(NULL)
```

```r
###OPTIONAL###
# ============================================================
# Configuration
# ============================================================
 
# --- Resolve a Python with RDKit: conda env if available, else pip virtualenv ---
activated <- FALSE
 
# 1) Try conda env first, but only if reticulate can actually find conda
conda_bin <- tryCatch(reticulate::conda_binary(), error = function(e) "")
if (nzchar(conda_bin)) {
  activated <- tryCatch({
    reticulate::use_condaenv("rdkit-env", conda = conda_bin, required = TRUE)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
}
 
# 2) Fall back to a pip virtualenv ONLY if conda didn't work; create it ONLY if missing
if (!activated) {
  if (!reticulate::virtualenv_exists("rdkit-env")) {
    reticulate::virtualenv_create("rdkit-env", packages = "rdkit")
  }
  reticulate::use_virtualenv("rdkit-env", required = TRUE)
}
 
reticulate::py_config()                       # confirm interpreter
```

```r
Chem <- reticulate::import("rdkit.Chem")
#Path to previously exported datasheet.
save_Location <- project_data_dir
 
#Saves cached smiles, if available, to avoid re-querying PubChem/CACTUS
CACHE_PATH <- paste0(save_Location, "smiles_cache.tsv")
 
# ============================================================
 
# 1) Load and merge data
#If not previously defined:
fileX   <- paste0(save_Location, "CondenScreenV2.xlsx")
#Note: the drug/gene/identifier must be name Reference (it automatically will be unless changed)
 
# 1) Load and merge data + build hits sheet (if needed_)
sheet_hits <- "Hits"
wb <- loadWorkbook(fileX)  # must load before referencing names(wb)
 
if (!sheet_hits %in% names(wb)) {
  # Build hits_df and write new sheet
  hits_df <- read.xlsx(fileX, sheet = "Combined Analysis") %>% filter(.data[[score_col]] >= 3)
  addWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
  writeData(wb, sheet_hits, hits_df)
  saveWorkbook(wb, fileX, overwrite = TRUE)
} else {
  hits_df <- read.xlsx(fileX, sheet = sheet_hits)
}
 
 
df_merged <-  hits_df %>%
  mutate(Reference = trimws(as.character(Reference)))
 
#Determines if reference already has SMILES chemical string available
has_smiles <- "SMILES" %in% colnames(df_merged) &&
              any(nzchar(trimws(df_merged$SMILES)), na.rm = TRUE)
 
df_merged <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    CAS    = if ("CAS" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(CAS) else NA_character_,
    SMILES = if ("SMILES" %in% colnames(.)) as.character(SMILES) else NA_character_
  )
 
# ============================================================
# 2) Cache management
# ============================================================
smiles_cache <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
 
if (file.exists(CACHE_PATH)) {
  cache_df <- readr::read_tsv(CACHE_PATH, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (nrow(cache_df) > 0) {
    purrr::walk2(cache_df$key, cache_df$value,
                 ~ assign(.x, .y, envir = smiles_cache))
  }
}
 
cache_get <- function(key) {
  if (exists(key, envir = smiles_cache, inherits = FALSE)) 
    get(key, envir = smiles_cache) 
  else NULL
}
 
cache_set <- function(key, value) assign(key, value, envir = smiles_cache)
 
cache_flush <- function() {
  keys <- ls(smiles_cache, all.names = TRUE)
  if (length(keys) > 0) {
    tibble::tibble(
      key = keys,
      value = vapply(keys, function(k) get(k, envir = smiles_cache), character(1))
    ) %>% readr::write_tsv(CACHE_PATH)
  }
}
 
 
# Only then import
Chem <- import("rdkit.Chem")
RDLogger <- import("rdkit.RDLogger")
RDLogger$DisableLog("rdApp.*")
# ============================================================
# 3) Identifier cleaning and SMILES retrieval
# ============================================================
 
#clean_cas -- experimental: Will try to increase the chance PubChem/CACTUS recognizes your CAS. May need adjustment on case-by-case basis
clean_cas <- function(x) {
  
  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(trimws(x))) return(NA_character_)
  x <- trimws(gsub("\\[.*?\\]", "", as.character(x)))
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, "[,;]")))
  parts <- parts[nzchar(parts)]
  if (length(parts) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  is_cas <- grepl("^\\d{2,7}-\\d{2}-\\d$", parts)
  if (any(is_cas)) parts[which(is_cas)[1]] else parts[1]
}
 
 
#clean SMILES:
normalize_key <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_character_)
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[\t\r\n]", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  tolower(x)
}
 
sanitize_smiles <- function(smi) {
  if (is.na(smi) || !nzchar(trimws(smi))) return(NA_character_)
  smi <- trimws(smi)
  smi <- gsub("[\t\r\n ]+", "", smi)
  smi <- gsub("\\|", ".", smi)
  smi
}
 
#Try parse SMILES into an RDKit molecule, else NULL
safe_mol <- function(smi) {
  if (is.na(smi) || !nzchar(trimws(smi))) return(NULL)
  tryCatch(Chem$MolFromSmiles(trimws(smi)), error = function(e) NULL)
}
 
is_valid_smiles <- function(smi) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  !is.null(mol)
}
 
 
 
#Returning SMILES:
#--------
#Will try to parse PubChem first for SMILES...
pubchem_smiles <- function(id, namespace = c("name", "rn"), timeout_s = 20) {
  namespace <- match.arg(namespace)
  if (is.na(id) || !nzchar(trimws(id))) return(NA_character_)
  
  url <- sprintf(
    "https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/rest/pug/compound/%s/%s/property/IsomericSMILES,CanonicalSMILES/JSON",
    namespace, URLencode(id, reserved = TRUE)
  )
  
  resp <- tryCatch(request(url) |> req_timeout(timeout_s) |> req_perform(), 
                   error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(resp) || resp_status(resp) >= 400) return(NA_character_)
  
  j <- tryCatch(fromJSON(resp_body_string(resp)), error = function(e) NULL)
  props <- j$PropertyTable$Properties
  if (is.null(props) || nrow(props) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  
  smi <- props$IsomericSMILES[1]
  if (is.null(smi) || is.na(smi) || !nzchar(smi)) smi <- props$CanonicalSMILES[1]
  if (is.null(smi) || is.na(smi) || !nzchar(smi)) NA_character_ else smi
}
 
 
#... but if fails will resort to CACTUS, NCI Chemical Identifier Resolver: https://cactus.nci.nih.gov/chemical/structure
cactus_smiles <- function(id, timeout_s = 20) {
  if (is.na(id) || !nzchar(trimws(id))) return(NA_character_)
 
  url <- sprintf("https://cactus.nci.nih.gov/chemical/structure/%s/smiles",
                 URLencode(id, reserved = TRUE))
 
  for (k in 1:3) {
    resp <- tryCatch(request(url) |> req_timeout(timeout_s) |> req_perform(),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(resp) && resp_status(resp) < 400) {
      smi <- sanitize_smiles(resp_body_string(resp))
      if (!is.na(smi) && !grepl("not found", smi, ignore.case = TRUE) && is_valid_smiles(smi)) {
        return(smi)
      }
    }
    Sys.sleep(0.5 * k)
  }
  NA_character_
}
 
get_smiles <- function(cas, name) {
  cas1  <- clean_cas(cas)
  name1 <- if (is.na(name) || !nzchar(trimws(name))) NA_character_ else trimws(name)
 
  # normalized cache keys
  key_rn <- if (!is.na(cas1)) paste0("RN:", normalize_key(cas1)) else NULL
  key_nm <- if (!is.na(name1)) paste0("NM:", normalize_key(name1)) else NULL
 
  # ---- cache check (use normalized keys only)
  for (key in c(key_rn, key_nm)) {
    if (!is.null(key)) {
      cached <- cache_get(key)
      if (!is.null(cached) && !identical(cached, "NA") && nzchar(cached)) {
        # sanitize/validate cached (in case old bad entries exist)
        cached2 <- sanitize_smiles(cached)
        if (!is.na(cached2) && is_valid_smiles(cached2)) return(cached2)
      }
      if (!is.null(cached) && identical(cached, "NA")) return(NA_character_)
    }
  }
 
  # ---- retrieval
  smi <- NA_character_
  if (!is.na(cas1)) smi <- pubchem_smiles(cas1, "rn")
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(name1)) smi <- pubchem_smiles(name1, "name")
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(cas1)) smi <- cactus_smiles(cas1)
  if (is.na(smi) && !is.na(name1)) smi <- cactus_smiles(name1)
 
  # ---- sanitize + validate
  smi <- sanitize_smiles(smi)
  if (!is.na(smi) && !is_valid_smiles(smi)) smi <- NA_character_
 
  # ---- cache (normalized keys only)
  if (!is.null(key_rn)) cache_set(key_rn, ifelse(is.na(smi), "NA", smi))
  if (!is.null(key_nm)) cache_set(key_nm, ifelse(is.na(smi), "NA", smi))
 
  smi
}
 
#--------
 
# Retrieve SMILES for all compounds
#Remove whitespace and replace with NA
df_hits <- df_merged %>%
  mutate(
    Reference = if_else(
      is.na(Reference) | trimws(Reference) == "",

# Identify rows that actually need lookup 
need_lookup <- with(
  df_hits,
  (is.na(SMILES) | !nzchar(trimws(SMILES))) &
  !(is.na(CAS) & is.na(Reference))
)
 
n_lookup <- sum(need_lookup)
 
if (n_lookup > 0) {
 
  idx <- which(need_lookup)
 
  message("Retrieving SMILES for ", n_lookup, " compounds")

  df_hits$SMILES[idx] <- vapply(

    function(i) {

      get_smiles(df_hits$CAS[i], df_hits$Reference[i])
    },
    character(1)
  )
 
  cache_flush()
 
} else {
  message("All compounds already have SMILES — no lookup performed")
}
```

```r
 
 
# ============================================================
# 4) RDKit setup and molecular processing
# ============================================================
 
#Import modules for describing molecular descriptors (e.g., molc. weight), cLogP, Lipinski counts, and safeguard measures.
Desc <- import("rdkit.Chem.Descriptors")
Crip <- import("rdkit.Chem.Crippen")
Lip <- import("rdkit.Chem.Lipinski")
rdMS <- import("rdkit.Chem.MolStandardize.rdMolStandardize")
uncharger <- rdMS$Uncharger()
largest_frag <- rdMS$LargestFragmentChooser()
 
 
 
#Try to edit SMILES format to reflect canonical SMILES [avoids salt charges, keeps largest fragment, etc.]
canonicalize_parent <- function(smiles) {
  if (is.na(smiles) || !nzchar(trimws(smiles))) return(NA_character_)
  
  mol <- safe_mol(smiles)
  if (is.null(mol)) return(NA_character_)
  
  mol <- tryCatch(uncharger$uncharge(mol), error = function(e) mol)
  mol <- tryCatch(largest_frag$choose(mol), error = function(e) mol)
  
  tryCatch(Chem$MolToSmiles(mol, canonical = TRUE, kekuleSmiles = FALSE),
           error = function(e) NA_character_)
}
 
# Process SMILES for property calculations
df_hits <- df_hits %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    SMILES_used = ifelse(
      is.na(SMILES) | SMILES == "",
      NA_character_,
      vapply(as.character(SMILES), canonicalize_parent, character(1))
    )
  )
# ============================================================
# 5) Load structural alerts
# ============================================================
 
#All credit for the initial chemical alerts goes to Pat Walters.
#See Pat Walter's GitHub, rd_fitlers, for more information: https://github.com/PatWalters/rd_filters.git
#The csv file can alternatively be downloaded directly with the rest of the CondenScreen code in https://github.com/SchliekerLab/Condenscreen-v1.1.git
 
 
 
 
get_alerts <- function(cache_dir = "nuisance_cache",
                       local_file = "alert_collection_PatWalters.csv") {
  dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  f_cache <- file.path(cache_dir, "alert_collection.csv")
  url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PatWalters/rd_filters/master/rd_filters/data/alert_collection.csv"
 
  # ---- Prefer local file, then cached file, else download ----
  if (file.exists(local_file)) {
    message("Using local alert file: ", local_file)
    al <- read.csv(local_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else if (file.exists(f_cache)) {
    message("Using cached alert file: ", f_cache)
    al <- read.csv(f_cache, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    message("Downloading alert collection from GitHub...")
    download.file(url, f_cache, mode = "wb")
    al <- read.csv(f_cache, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
 
  # ---- Detect column names (robust to schema changes) ----
  nms <- names(al)
 
  smarts_col <- nms[grep("smarts", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_set numeric (e.g., 2,3,4...) if present
  rule_set_col <- nms[grep("^rule.?set$|rule_set", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_set_name (e.g., PAINS, Glaxo, GSK...) if present
  set_name_col <- nms[grep("rule.?set.?name|set_name|ruleset_name|rule_set_name", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # rule_id numeric
  id_col <- nms[grep("^rule.?id$|rule_id", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  # description/name field (human readable), best-effort
  desc_col <- nms[grep("description|desc|name|alert_name|label", nms, ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
 
  if (is.na(smarts_col) || is.na(id_col) || (is.na(rule_set_col) && is.na(set_name_col))) {
    stop(
      "Could not detect required columns in alert CSV. Found columns: ",
      paste(nms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
 
  # ---- Normalize ----
  alerts <- dplyr::as_tibble(al) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      rule_set      = if (!is.na(rule_set_col)) as.integer(.data[[rule_set_col]]) else NA_integer_,
      rule_set_name = if (!is.na(set_name_col)) as.character(.data[[set_name_col]]) else NA_character_,
      rule_id       = suppressWarnings(as.integer(.data[[id_col]])),
      description   = if (!is.na(desc_col)) as.character(.data[[desc_col]]) else NA_character_,
      smarts        = as.character(.data[[smarts_col]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(smarts), nzchar(smarts)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rule_id)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # if rule_set_name missing, fall back to rule_set as text
      rule_set_name = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(rule_set_name) | !nzchar(rule_set_name),
        ifelse(!is.na(rule_set), paste0("RuleSet_", rule_set), "UnknownSet"),
        rule_set_name
      ),
      # stable ID uses numeric rule_set if available; else build stable-ish id from set_name
      alert_id = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(rule_set),
        paste0(rule_set, ":", rule_id),
        paste0(rule_set_name, ":", rule_id)
      ),
      # human-readable label
      label = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(description) & nzchar(description),
        paste0(alert_id, " | ", rule_set_name, " | ", description),
        paste0(alert_id, " | ", rule_set_name)
      )
    )
 
  # ---- Split and compile patterns ----
  split(alerts, alerts$rule_set_name) %>%
    purrr::map(function(d) {
      tibble::tibble(
        rule_set_name = d$rule_set_name[1],
        rule_set      = d$rule_set[1],
        rule_id       = d$rule_id,
        alert_id      = d$alert_id,
        description   = d$description,
        smarts        = d$smarts,
        label         = d$label,
        patt          = purrr::map(d$smarts, ~ tryCatch(Chem$MolFromSmarts(.x), error = function(e) NULL))
      ) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!purrr::map_lgl(patt, is.null))
    })
}
 
compiled_sets <- get_alerts()
 
flag_molecule <- function(smi, compiled_sets) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) return("")
  
  hits <- c()
  
  for (set_name in names(compiled_sets)) {
    tbl <- compiled_sets[[set_name]]
    
    matched <- purrr::map_lgl(tbl$patt, ~ mol$HasSubstructMatch(.x))
    
    if (any(matched)) {
      hits <- c(hits, tbl$label[matched])
    }
  }
  
  if (length(hits) == 0) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste(unique(hits), collapse = " | ")
  }
}
 
 
calc_lipinski <- function(smi) {
  mol <- safe_mol(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) {
    return(tibble::tibble(MW = NA_real_, LogP = NA_real_, HBD = NA_real_, 
                          HBA = NA_real_, Lipinski = NA_character_, 
                          Lipinski_Passed = NA_character_, Lipinski_Failed = NA_character_))
  }
  
  MW <- as.numeric(Desc$MolWt(mol))
  LogP <- as.numeric(Crip$MolLogP(mol))
  HBD <- as.numeric(Lip$NumHDonors(mol))
  HBA <- as.numeric(Lip$NumHAcceptors(mol))
  
  passed <- c(
    if (!is.na(MW) && MW <= 500) "MW<=500",
    if (!is.na(LogP) && LogP <= 5) "LogP<=5",
    if (!is.na(HBD) && HBD <= 5) "HBD<=5",
    if (!is.na(HBA) && HBA <= 10) "HBA<=10"
  )
  
  failed <- c(
    if (!is.na(MW) && MW > 500) "MW>500",
    if (!is.na(LogP) && LogP > 5) "LogP>5",
    if (!is.na(HBD) && HBD > 5) "HBD>5",
    if (!is.na(HBA) && HBA > 10) "HBA>10"
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    MW = MW, LogP = LogP, HBD = HBD, HBA = HBA,
    Lipinski = if (length(failed) == 0) "Pass" else "Fail",
    Lipinski_Passed = paste(passed, collapse = ", "),
    Lipinski_Failed = paste(failed, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
# ============================================================
# 6) Compute properties for unique SMILES
# ============================================================
unique_smiles <- df_hits %>%
  filter(!is.na(SMILES_used), SMILES_used != "") %>%
  distinct(SMILES_used)
 
cat("Computing properties for", nrow(unique_smiles), "unique SMILES...\n")
```

```r
smis <- unique_smiles$SMILES_used
n <- length(smis)
 
pb <- progress::progress_bar$new(
  format = "RDKit [:bar] :current/:total :percent | eta: :eta",
  total  = n,
  clear  = FALSE,
  width  = 60
)
 
properties_list <- vector("list", n)
 
for (i in seq_len(n)) {
  pb$tick()
 
  smi <- smis[i]
 
  flags <- flag_molecule(smi, compiled_sets)
  props <- calc_lipinski(smi)
 
  properties_list[[i]] <- cbind(
    tibble::tibble(SMILES_used = smi, alert_flags = flags),
    props
  )
}
 
properties_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(properties_list)
 
# ============================================================
# 7) Join properties and calculate risk scores
# ============================================================
# Chemical Liability Scoring Framework (Max-Based Tier System)
#
# This scoring system assigns compounds to liability tiers based on the
# highest-severity flag present rather than summing penalties. This avoids
# artificial inflation when multiple related alerts are triggered.
# The PAINS/MLSMR/BMS/GSK/Glaxo/LINT/Dundee/Inpharmatica/SureChEMBL are based on the the ChEMBL database and Pat Walters work.
# See https://github.com/PatWalters/rd_filters.git
 
# Tier definitions:
 
#   Score 10 (ELEVATED):
#     - PAINS compounds 
#     - Cytotoxicity (≥25% viability loss)
#
#   Score 5 (MODERATE):
#     - Industry structural alerts (MLSMR / NIH structural alerts, BMS, GSK, Glaxo, LINT, Dundee)
#     - secondary marker reporter suppression (≥25% loss)
#
#   Score 2 (MINOR):
#     - Lipinski rule-of-five violations
#     - Inpharmatica / SureChEMBL alerts
 
# Risk categories:
#   10  -> "ELEVATED"
#   5   -> "MODERATE"
#   2   -> "MINOR"
#   0   -> "CLEAN"
 
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 
df_final <- df_hits %>%
  left_join(properties_tbl, by = "SMILES_used", suffix = c(".old", "")) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".old")) %>%
  mutate(
    Viability = if ("Viability" %in% names(.)) Viability else NA_real_,
    SecondaryMarker = if ("SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff" %in% names(.)) {
    SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff <= -25 &
      if ("residual" %in% names(.)) is.na(residual) else TRUE
  } else FALSE,
    
 
    Cytotoxic = !is.na(Viability) & (Viability <= -25),
 
    has_smiles = !is.na(SMILES_used) & nzchar(trimws(SMILES_used)),
    flags = if_else(has_smiles, coalesce(alert_flags, ""), ""),
 
    # --- Flag categories ---
    High_Flag = grepl("PAINS", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) | Cytotoxic,
 
    Moderate_Flag = grepl("BMS|GLAXO|GSK|LINT|DUNDEE|MLSMR|NIH", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) | SecondaryMarker,
 
    Mild_Flag = grepl("INPHARMATICA|SURECHEMBL", flags, ignore.case = TRUE) |
                (!is.na(Lipinski_Failed) & Lipinski_Failed > 0),
 
    # --- Max-based score ---
    AlertScore = pmax(
      if_else(High_Flag, 10L, 0L),
      if_else(Moderate_Flag, 5L, 0L),
      if_else(Mild_Flag, 2L, 0L)
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Risk = case_when(
      !has_smiles        ~ "UNKNOWN",
      AlertScore >= 10   ~ "ELEVATED",
      AlertScore >= 5    ~ "MODERATE",
      AlertScore >= 2    ~ "MINOR",
      TRUE               ~ "CLEAN"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Explicit, human-readable reason for each flag tier. `flags`/`alert_flags`
    # only ever holds structural-alert names, so a row flagged solely via
    # SecondaryMarker or Cytotoxic (not a structural alert match) previously
    # showed an empty/unrelated alert string with no visible explanation.
    AlertReason = purrr::pmap_chr(
      list(has_smiles, High_Flag, Cytotoxic, flags, Moderate_Flag, SecondaryMarker, Mild_Flag, Lipinski_Failed),
      function(has_smiles, High_Flag, Cytotoxic, flags, Moderate_Flag, SecondaryMarker, Mild_Flag, Lipinski_Failed) {
        if (!has_smiles) return(NA_character_)
        reasons <- character(0)
        if (High_Flag) {
          if (grepl("PAINS", flags, ignore.case = TRUE)) reasons <- c(reasons, "PAINS structural alert")
          if (Cytotoxic) reasons <- c(reasons, "Cytotoxicity (Viability <= -25%)")
        }
        if (Moderate_Flag) {
          industry_hit <- regmatches(flags, regexpr("BMS|GLAXO|GSK|LINT|DUNDEE|MLSMR|NIH", flags, ignore.case = TRUE))
          if (length(industry_hit) > 0 && nzchar(industry_hit)) reasons <- c(reasons, paste0(industry_hit, " structural alert"))
          if (isTRUE(SecondaryMarker)) reasons <- c(reasons, "Secondary marker suppression (>=25% drop from plate mean)")
        }
        if (Mild_Flag) {
          if (grepl("INPHARMATICA|SURECHEMBL", flags, ignore.case = TRUE)) reasons <- c(reasons, "Inpharmatica/SureChEMBL structural alert")
          if (!is.na(Lipinski_Failed) && Lipinski_Failed > 0) reasons <- c(reasons, "Lipinski rule-of-five violation")
        }
        if (length(reasons) == 0) return("None")
        paste(reasons, collapse = "; ")
      }
    )
  )

# Confirm/quantify explicitly, rather than leaving it as an assumption: how
# many MODERATE-risk hits owe that entirely to secondary marker suppression,
# with no structural alert contributing.
n_moderate_secondary_only <- df_final %>%
  filter(Risk == "MODERATE", isTRUE(SecondaryMarker),
         !grepl("BMS|GLAXO|GSK|LINT|DUNDEE|MLSMR|NIH", flags, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  nrow()
n_moderate_total <- sum(df_final$Risk == "MODERATE", na.rm = TRUE)
cat(n_moderate_secondary_only, "of", n_moderate_total,
    "MODERATE-risk hits are flagged solely due to secondary marker suppression",
    "(>=25% drop from plate mean), with no structural alert match. See AlertReason.\n")
```

```r
chem_cols_chr <- c("flags", "Lipinski", "Lipinski_Failed")
chem_cols_num <- c("AlertScore", "MW", "LogP", "HBD", "HBA")
chem_cols_lgl <- c("PAINS_NIH_Flagged", "Industry_Flagged", "Other_Flagged")

  mutate(
    across(any_of(chem_cols_num), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA_real_)),
    across(any_of(chem_cols_chr), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA_character_)),
    across(any_of(chem_cols_lgl), ~ if_else(has_smiles, .x, NA))
  ) %>%
  select(-has_smiles)
 
 
#Select important columns for exporting:
df_final <- df_final %>%
  select(any_of(c(
    "Reference", "Plate", "Well",
    "BZScore", "ZScore", "BScore", "PercentEffect",
    "Viability", "Risk", "PlateZPrimeScore", "Systematic_error", "QC_alpha",
    "AvgFoci", "Average_foci_perCell", "CellCount", "CellCountPercentDiff",
    "AssayType", "SecondaryMarker_Intensity", "SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff", "residual", "Cytotoxic",
    "CAS", "SMILES_used", "MW", "LogP", "HBD", "HBA", "Lipinski", "Lipinski_Failed",
    "AlertScore", "alert_flags", "AlertReason"
  )))
# ============================================================
# 8) Write back to Excel
# ============================================================
 
#Overwrite previous hits sheet in original workbook to add chemical triage labels:
 
sheet_hits <- "Hits"
 
# (optional) make factors safe for Excel
df_final <- df_final %>% mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
 
# 2) Load the existing workbook and overwrite the Hits sheet
wb <- loadWorkbook(fileX)
 
 
if (sheet_hits %in% names(wb)) removeWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
addWorksheet(wb, sheet_hits)
 
#Order by BZ-Score (descending)
df_final <- df_final %>% arrange(desc(if ("BZScore" %in% names(.)) BZScore else ZScore))
writeData(wb, sheet_hits, df_final, startCol = 1, startRow = 1, colNames = TRUE)
 
freezePane(wb, sheet_hits, firstActiveRow = 2)
addFilter(wb, sheet_hits, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(df_final))
 
# Desired sheets (in order). Replicates is optional -- only present if any
# Reference actually had >1 record. It was missing from this list entirely,
# so the pruning loop below silently deleted it (along with anything else not
# on the list) every time this chunk ran.
new_order <- c("Hits", "Combined Analysis", "Plate Statistics", "Controls")
if (sheet_reps %in% names(wb)) new_order <- c(new_order, sheet_reps)

# Remove unwanted sheets
for (sh in setdiff(names(wb), new_order)) {
  removeWorksheet(wb, sh)
}
 
# Reorder by matching positions
worksheetOrder(wb) <- match(new_order, names(wb))
 
 
saveWorkbook(wb, fileX, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```r
# RDKit imports
rdkit       <- import("rdkit")
Chem        <- rdkit$Chem
AllChem     <- rdkit$Chem$AllChem
DataStructs <- rdkit$DataStructs
Draw        <- import("rdkit.Chem.Draw")
MolDrawing  <- import("rdkit.Chem.Draw.rdMolDraw2D")
 
# ── Output directory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out_dir <- save_Location
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
 
 
# ── Restrict Tanimoto/cheminformatics analysis to confirmed hits ────────────────
# Only compounds with BZ/Z-Score > 3 that pass viability (Viability >= -50) and,
# if a secondary marker channel exists, pass the secondary marker filter. This mirrors the
# viab_ok / secondary_marker_ok conventions used elsewhere (SecondaryMarker here is the "failed"
# drop flag, so passing == !SecondaryMarker).
# Resolves against df_final's OWN populated-ness of BZScore/ZScore -- NOT the
# inherited session-level `score_col`. score_col was resolved against the full
# merged_df, which can have finite BZScore values overall while the (smaller)
# hits-only df_final subset is entirely NA for that same column, e.g. when none
# of the confirmed hits happened to land on the B-score-eligible replicate.
# Reusing score_col blindly turns `.data[[score_col_chem]] > 3` into NA for
# every row here, which filter() drops -- silently zeroing out df_chem instead
# of falling back to ZScore. resolve_score_col() (defined above) checks
# is.finite(), not just column existence, so apply it to df_final directly.
score_col_chem <- if ("BZScore" %in% names(df_final) && any(is.finite(df_final$BZScore))) {
  "BZScore"
} else if ("ZScore" %in% names(df_final) && any(is.finite(df_final$ZScore))) {
  "ZScore"
} else if (exists("score_col")) {
  score_col  # last resort for a standalone restart where df_final itself has no finite score at all
} else {
  stop("Neither BZScore nor ZScore has any finite values in df_final -- ",
       "check the upstream normalization/averaging step before this block runs.")
}
 
df_chem <- df_final %>%
  filter(
    .data[[score_col_chem]] > 3,
    is.na(Viability) | Viability >= -50,
    # Matches the Export Hits convention (secondary_marker_ok): pass if the
    # secondary marker channel isn't in use, the diff column is missing/NA, or
    # the drop from plate mean is within 25%. Previously this checked
    # `!SecondaryMarker_Intensity`, which coerces a continuous intensity value
    # to logical (TRUE only when exactly 0) -- effectively always FALSE, so it
    # silently dropped every row regardless of score/viability.
    if (has_secondary_marker && "SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff" %in% names(.)) {
      is.na(SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff) | SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff >= -25
    } else TRUE
  )
 
message("Cheminformatics: ", nrow(df_chem), " of ", nrow(df_final),
        " hits pass BZ/Z>3, viability, and secondary marker filters.")
 
# ── Molecular Fingerprinting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fps <- lapply(df_chem$SMILES_used, function(smi) {
  mol <- Chem$MolFromSmiles(smi)
  if (is.null(mol)) return(NULL)
  AllChem$GetMorganFingerprintAsBitVect(mol, radius = 2L, nBits = 2048L)
})
valid <- !sapply(fps, is.null)
fps   <- fps[valid]
refs  <- df_chem$Reference[valid]
 
 
# ── Tanimoto similarity matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
n <- length(fps)
sim_matrix <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = list(refs, refs))
for (i in seq_len(n))
  for (j in seq_len(n))
    sim_matrix[i, j] <- DataStructs$TanimotoSimilarity(fps[[i]], fps[[j]])
 
# ── Palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
diverging_owp    <- colorRampPalette(c("#E87D3E", "#F5C9A0", "white", "#9B8EC4", "#3B2A6E"))(100)
sequential_pdark <- colorRampPalette(c("#F5D0D8", "#C98BAA", "#7B3F7A", "#3A1050", "#0F0318"))(100)
bar_fill         <- "darkgray"
umap_colors <- c("NT Ctrl" = "#F4A8B0", "RNF26" = "#F5C89A", "ZNF335" = "#C8B8E0")
 
# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
make_legend <- function(ref, hits_df) {
  row <- hits_df %>% filter(Reference == ref)
  paste0(ref, " | Effect:", sprintf("%.1f", row$PercentEffect),
         " | td:", sprintf("%.1f", row$SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff))
}
strip_name <- function(mol) { mol$SetProp("_Name", ""); mol }
 
opts <- MolDrawing$MolDrawOptions()
opts$legendFontSize <- 22L
opts$legendFraction <- 0.15
opts$padding        <- 0.05
 
# ── Mol objects ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
mols       <- lapply(df_chem$SMILES_used, function(smi) Chem$MolFromSmiles(smi))
valid_mol  <- !sapply(mols, is.null)
mols_valid <- mols[valid_mol]
refs_valid <- df_chem$Reference[valid_mol]
 
#------------------------
#Figure Generation:
#------------------------
# Turn whatever MolsToGridImage returns into a PNG file on disk
grid_png_to_file <- function(obj, path) {
  if (is.raw(obj)) { writeBin(obj, path); return(invisible(path)) }
  rawc <- tryCatch(reticulate::py_to_r(obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.raw(rawc)) { writeBin(rawc, path); return(invisible(path)) }
  if (inherits(obj, "python.builtin.bytes")) {            # your case: write via Python
    bi  <- reticulate::import_builtins()
    con <- bi$open(path, "wb"); con$write(obj); con$close()
    return(invisible(path))
  }
  if (!is.null(tryCatch(obj$save, error = function(e) NULL))) {  # PIL Image fallback
    obj$save(path); return(invisible(path))
  }
  stop("Unrecognized MolsToGridImage return: ", paste(class(obj), collapse = ", "))
}
# ── Structural clustering (Butina / Taylor-Butina) ──────────────────────────────
# Butina clustering greedily picks centroids with the most neighbors within the
# distance cutoff, giving compact, centroid-based clusters. This is more
# defensible than a simple similarity-threshold graph (igraph::components),
# which performs single-linkage clustering and can chain compounds together
# transitively even when the endpoints aren't very similar to each other.
# Computed up-front (before the MDS plot) so cluster membership can be used
# to color the MDS scatter.
Butina <- import("rdkit.ML.Cluster.Butina")
 
# Tanimoto DISTANCE cutoff (1 - similarity). 0.6 distance == 0.4 similarity,
# matching the threshold used previously.
cluster_cutoff <- 0.7
 
n_chem <- length(refs_valid)
if (n_chem >= 2) {
  dist_vec <- numeric(n_chem * (n_chem - 1) / 2)
  k <- 1L
  for (i in 2:n_chem) {
    for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
      dist_vec[k] <- 1 - sim_matrix[i, j]
      k <- k + 1L
    }
  }
} else {
  dist_vec <- numeric(0)
}
 
butina_clusters <- Butina$ClusterData(dist_vec, n_chem, cluster_cutoff, isDistData = TRUE)
 
# The first index in each Butina tuple is the cluster centroid (the compound
# with the most neighbors within the cutoff) -- a natural structural
# representative for that cluster.
# Guard: with 0 (or 1) valid compounds, butina_clusters is empty and
# bind_rows(list()) returns a tibble with NO columns at all (not just zero
# rows) -- arrange(Group) then errors with "object 'Group' not found" because
# there's nothing to bind. Give cluster_all_df its expected columns explicitly
# in that case so every chunk downstream that references Reference/Group/
# Representative keeps working on an empty (but correctly shaped) table.
if (n_chem == 0) {
  cat("No compounds passed the cheminformatics filters (df_chem is empty) -- ",
      "skipping clustering; downstream cluster tables/plots will be empty.\n")
}
```

```r
cluster_all_df <- if (length(butina_clusters) == 0) {
  tibble::tibble(Reference = character(0), Group = integer(0), Representative = logical(0))
} else {
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(butina_clusters), function(g) {
    idx <- unlist(butina_clusters[[g]]) + 1L  # python 0-based -> R 1-based
    data.frame(
      Reference      = refs_valid[idx],
      Group          = g,
      Representative = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, length(idx) - 1)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })) %>% arrange(Group)
}
 
# Multi-compound clusters only, for the IMAGE 5 structure grid
component_df <- cluster_all_df %>%
  group_by(Group) %>% filter(n() > 1) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(Group)
 
cluster_summary <- component_df %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), compounds = paste(Reference, collapse = ", "))
 
# Everything below (heatmap, similarity distribution, MDS/PCoA, UMAP, cluster
# images, and the final cheminformatics_results.xlsx export) requires at least
# 2 valid compounds -- a dist object / pheatmap / cmdscale on 0 or 1 points is
# undefined and throws opaque errors (e.g. `distance[1] == "correlation"` on a
# zero-length dist evaluates to NA, not FALSE, which crashes the if-check
# inside pheatmap). Skip the whole image/export block gracefully instead.
if (n_chem >= 2) {

# ── IMAGE 1: Heatmap ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#Convert from similarity to distance matrix for heatmap clustering:
tanimoto_dist <- as.dist(1 - sim_matrix)
 
png(file.path(out_dir, "tanimoto_heatmap.png"), width = 2800, height = 2400, res = 300)
pheatmap(sim_matrix,                        # still display the similarity values
         clustering_distance_rows = tanimoto_dist,
         clustering_distance_cols = tanimoto_dist,
         clustering_method = "ward.D2",
         color = diverging_owp,
         show_rownames = TRUE,
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         fontsize_row = 5,
         fontsize_col = 5)
dev.off()
 
# ── IMAGE 2: Similarity distribution ──────────────────────────────────────────
sim_vals <- melt(sim_matrix) %>% filter(Var1 != Var2)
p_dist <- ggplot(sim_vals, aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = bar_fill, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", color = "#E87D3E") +
  labs(title = "Pairwise Tanimoto Similarity Distribution",
       x = "Tanimoto Similarity", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "tanimoto_distribution.png"), p_dist, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 150)
 
# ── IMAGE 3: MDS (PCoA) scatter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# UMAP is unstable/unreliable for small N. Classical MDS (cmdscale) on the
# Tanimoto distance matrix is deterministic and behaves sensibly at any N.
# Column names kept as UMAP1/UMAP2/umap_df to avoid disrupting the Excel export.
dist_matrix <- 1 - sim_matrix
n_items     <- nrow(dist_matrix)
 
if (n_items >= 3) {
  mds_res <- cmdscale(as.dist(dist_matrix), k = min(2L, n_items - 1L))
 
  if (ncol(mds_res) < 2) mds_res <- cbind(mds_res, 0)  # guard for k=1 edge case
 
  umap_df <- data.frame(UMAP1 = mds_res[, 1],
                         UMAP2 = mds_res[, 2],
                         Reference = rownames(sim_matrix))
  p_umap <- ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = Reference)) +
    geom_point(color = bar_fill, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "MDS (PCoA) of Chemical Fingerprint Similarity",
         x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "umap_scatter.png"), p_umap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150)
} else {
  message("Too few compounds (", n_items, ") for a meaningful MDS plot -- skipping plot.")
  umap_df <- data.frame(UMAP1 = NA_real_, UMAP2 = NA_real_,
                        Reference = rownames(sim_matrix))   # keeps the Excel sheet working
}
 
# ── IMAGE 3b: MDS scatter colored by structural (Butina) cluster ───────────────
# Same MDS embedding as IMAGE 3, but colored by Butina cluster membership so
# you can see at a glance which hits are structurally related. Singletons
# (clusters of size 1) are grouped into a single "Unclustered" category and
# shown in gray so the discrete color scale isn't dominated by one-off groups.
if (n_items >= 3 && exists("cluster_all_df")) {
  cluster_sizes <- cluster_all_df %>% count(Group)
  multi_groups  <- cluster_sizes$Group[cluster_sizes$n > 1]
 
  umap_cluster_df <- umap_df %>%
    left_join(cluster_all_df %>% select(Reference, Group), by = "Reference") %>%
    mutate(
      ClusterLabel = if_else(Group %in% multi_groups,
                              paste0("Cluster ", Group),
                              "Unclustered")
    )
 
  # Stable color assignment: real clusters get the qualitative palette,
  # "Unclustered" is always gray regardless of how many clusters exist.
  named_levels <- sort(unique(umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel[umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel != "Unclustered"]))
  cluster_levels <- c(named_levels, "Unclustered")
 
  cluster_colors <- if (length(named_levels) > 0) scales::hue_pal()(length(named_levels)) else character(0)
  cluster_palette <- setNames(c(cluster_colors, "gray70"), cluster_levels)
 
  umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel <- factor(umap_cluster_df$ClusterLabel, levels = cluster_levels)
 
  p_umap_clusters <- ggplot(umap_cluster_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, label = Reference, color = ClusterLabel)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_palette) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = "MDS (PCoA) Colored by Structural Cluster (Butina)",
         x = "MDS1", y = "MDS2", color = "Cluster")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "mds_scatter_clusters.png"), p_umap_clusters, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 150)
} else {
  message("Skipping cluster-colored MDS plot (too few compounds or no cluster data).")
}
 
# ── IMAGE 4: All hits structure grid ──────────────────────────────────────────
legends_all <- sapply(refs_valid, make_legend, hits_df = df_merged)
mols_clean  <- lapply(mols_valid, strip_name)
 
img_obj <- Draw$MolsToGridImage(mols_clean, molsPerRow = 6L, subImgSize = c(600L, 500L),
                                legends = as.list(unname(legends_all)),
                                drawOptions = opts, returnPNG = TRUE)
#writeBin(grid_png_raw(img_obj), file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures.png"))
grid_png_to_file(img_obj, file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures.png"))
 
# ── IMAGE 5: One row per cluster, structures + text separated via magick ───────
library(magick)
 
 
groups_unique <- sort(unique(component_df$Group))
 
groups_unique <- sort(unique(component_df$Group))
 
if (length(groups_unique) == 0) {
  message("No multi-compound clusters (Tanimoto > 0.4) -- skipping grouped structure grid.")
} else {
 
  # image_annotate() runs text through ImageMagick's MVG "text" primitive,
  # which can choke on quotes/percent signs/newlines in compound names and
  # throw "non-conforming drawing primitive definition `text'". Side-step
  # that entirely by rendering text with base R graphics (png + text()) and
  # reading the result back in as an image. Defined here (shared scope) so
  # both the per-compound text panels and the cluster banners can use it.
  safe_text <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x[is.na(x)] <- ""
    x <- iconv(x, from = "", to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT", sub = "")
    gsub("[\r\n\t]", " ", x)
  }
 
  make_banner <- function(text, width_px, height_px = 50) {
    tmp_banner <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
 
    png(tmp_banner, width = width_px, height = height_px, bg = "#EDE9F5", res = 120)
    par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
    plot.new()
    plot.window(xlim = c(0, width_px), ylim = c(height_px, 0))
 
    text(x = 16, y = height_px / 2, labels = safe_text(text), adj = c(0, 0.5),
         cex = 1.6, col = "#3B2A6E", font = 2, family = "sans")
 
    dev.off()
    image_read(tmp_banner)
  }
 
  cluster_images <- lapply(groups_unique, function(grp) {
 
    # ── Compounds in this cluster ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    refs_in_grp <- component_df$Reference[component_df$Group == grp]
    idx_in_grp  <- match(refs_in_grp, refs_valid)
    valid_idx   <- !is.na(idx_in_grp)
    refs_in_grp <- refs_in_grp[valid_idx]
    idx_in_grp  <- idx_in_grp[valid_idx]
    n_in_grp    <- length(refs_in_grp)
 
    # ── 1. Draw structures with no legend ──────────────────────────────────────
    mols_grp   <- lapply(mols_valid[idx_in_grp], strip_name)
    blank_legs <- as.list(rep("", n_in_grp))
 
    struct_obj <- Draw$MolsToGridImage(mols_grp, molsPerRow = as.integer(n_in_grp),
                                       subImgSize = c(600L, 500L), legends = blank_legs,
                                       drawOptions = opts, returnPNG = TRUE)
    tmp_png    <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
    grid_png_to_file(struct_obj, tmp_png)
    struct_img <- image_read(tmp_png)
    struct_w   <- image_info(struct_img)$width
    cell_w     <- as.integer(struct_w / n_in_grp)
 
    # ── 2. Build text panel for each compound ──────────────────────────────────
    make_text_panel <- function(lines, width_px, height_px, fontsize = 22) {
      tmp_txt <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
 
      png(tmp_txt, width = width_px, height = height_px, bg = "white", res = 120)
      par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
      plot.new()
      plot.window(xlim = c(0, width_px), ylim = c(height_px, 0))
 
      y <- 28
      for (ln in lines) {
        text(x = 20, y = y, labels = safe_text(ln), adj = c(0, 0),
             cex = fontsize / 18, col = "#222222", family = "sans")
        y <- y + 30
      }
 
      dev.off()
      image_read(tmp_txt)
    }
 
    text_panels <- lapply(seq_len(n_in_grp), function(i) {
      ref <- refs_in_grp[i]
      row <- df_merged %>% filter(Reference == ref) %>% slice(1)
 
      eff_val <- if ("PercentEffect" %in% names(row)) row$PercentEffect[1] else NA_real_
      secondary_marker_val  <- if ("SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff" %in% names(row)) row$SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff[1] else NA_real_
 
      others    <- setdiff(seq_len(n_in_grp), i)
      tan_lines <- sapply(others, function(j) {
        t_val <- DataStructs$TanimotoSimilarity(fps[[idx_in_grp[i]]], fps[[idx_in_grp[j]]])
        sprintf("  vs %s:  %.2f", refs_in_grp[j], t_val)
      })
 
      lines <- c(
        ref,
        sprintf("Eff: %.1f  |  td: %.1f", eff_val, secondary_marker_val),
        strrep("-", 20),
        "Tanimoto:",
        tan_lines
      )
      panel_h <- 40 + length(lines) * 30
 
      make_text_panel(lines = lines, width_px = cell_w, height_px = panel_h, fontsize = 22)
    })
 
    # ── 3. Stitch text panels side by side ─────────────────────────────────────
    text_row <- image_append(do.call(c, text_panels), stack = FALSE)
    text_w   <- image_info(text_row)$width
    if (text_w < struct_w) {
      text_row <- image_extent(text_row,
                               geometry = paste0(struct_w, "x", image_info(text_row)$height),
                               gravity = "West", color = "white")
    }
 
    # ── 4. Stack structures on top of text ─────────────────────────────────────
    image_append(c(struct_img, text_row), stack = TRUE)
  })
 
  # ── Banners + stack all rows ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  max_width  <- max(sapply(cluster_images, function(img) image_info(img)$width))
  final_rows <- lapply(seq_along(cluster_images), function(i) {
    grp <- groups_unique[i]
    n   <- sum(component_df$Group == grp)
    img <- cluster_images[[i]]
 
    if (image_info(img)$width < max_width) {
      img <- image_extent(img, geometry = paste0(max_width, "x", image_info(img)$height),
                          gravity = "West", color = "white")
    }
 
    banner <- make_banner(text = sprintf("Cluster %d  (%d compounds)", grp, n),
                          width_px = max_width, height_px = 50)
 
    image_append(c(banner, img), stack = TRUE)
  })
 
  final_img <- image_append(do.call(c, final_rows), stack = TRUE)
  image_write(final_img, file.path(out_dir, "hits_structures_grouped.png"))
  message("Saved: hits_structures_grouped.png")
}
# ── EXCEL EXPORT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
wb <- createWorkbook()
 
header_style    <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 11, fontColour = "white",
                               fgFill = "#3B2A6E", halign = "center",
                               textDecoration = "bold", border = "Bottom")
cell_style      <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.0000",
                               halign = "center", border = "LeftRight", borderColour = "#CCCCCC")
cell_style_text <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, halign = "left")
cell_style_num  <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0.0000", halign = "right")
cell_style_int  <- createStyle(fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10, numFmt = "0", halign = "center")
 
# ── Sheet 1: Tanimoto Similarity Matrix ───────────────────────────────────────
addWorksheet(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity")
sim_df <- cbind(Reference = rownames(sim_matrix), as.data.frame(sim_matrix))
rownames(sim_df) <- NULL
writeData(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", sim_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_rows <- nrow(sim_df); n_cols <- ncol(sim_df)
conditionalFormatting(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 2:n_cols, rows = 2:(n_rows + 1),
                      style = c("#FFFFFF", "#7B3F7A"), rule = c(0, 1), type = "colourScale")
addStyle(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", style = cell_style,
         rows = 2:(n_rows + 1), cols = 2:n_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_rows + 1), cols = 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 1,
             widths = max(nchar(as.character(sim_df$Reference))) * 1.2 + 2)
setColWidths(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", cols = 2:n_cols, widths = 10)
freezePane(wb, "Tanimoto Similarity", firstRow = TRUE, firstCol = TRUE)
 
# ── Sheet 2: UMAP Results ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
addWorksheet(wb, "UMAP Results")
writeData(wb, "UMAP Results", umap_df, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_umap_rows <- nrow(umap_df)
addStyle(wb, "UMAP Results", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_umap_rows + 1), cols = 1, gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "UMAP Results", style = cell_style_num,
         rows = 2:(n_umap_rows + 1), cols = 2:3, gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(wb, "UMAP Results", cols = 1, widths = 25)
setColWidths(wb, "UMAP Results", cols = 2:3, widths = 14)
freezePane(wb, "UMAP Results", firstRow = TRUE, firstCol = FALSE)
 
# ── Sheet 3: Cluster Assignments ───────────────────────────────────────────────
# Includes ALL Butina clusters (singletons too), plus:
#   - Representative: structural centroid of the cluster (most neighbors within
#     the Tanimoto distance cutoff)
#   - Score: BZ/Z-Score (whichever applies) for the compound
#   - Hit: TRUE if the compound's Score exceeds 3 (Z- or BZ-Score, whichever
#     column applies for this run).
addWorksheet(wb, "Clusters")
cluster_export <- cluster_all_df %>%
  left_join(df_merged %>% select(any_of(c("Reference", "PercentEffect", "SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff"))), by = "Reference") %>%
  left_join(df_chem %>% select(Reference, Score = all_of(score_col_chem)), by = "Reference") %>%
  group_by(Group) %>%
  mutate(Hit = Score > 3) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Group, desc(Score))
cluster_export$Group <- as.integer(cluster_export$Group)
writeData(wb, "Clusters", cluster_export, startRow = 1, startCol = 1,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
n_cluster_rows  <- nrow(cluster_export)
n_cluster_cols  <- ncol(cluster_export)
cluster_colnames <- names(cluster_export)
 
# Numeric columns vary depending on whether SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff exists for this run
numeric_cols <- match(intersect(c("PercentEffect", "SecondaryMarker_Intensity_Diff", "Score"), cluster_colnames),
                       cluster_colnames)
 
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_text,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = match("Reference", cluster_colnames), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_int,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = match("Group", cluster_colnames), gridExpand = TRUE)
addStyle(wb, "Clusters", style = cell_style_num,
         rows = 2:(n_cluster_rows + 1), cols = numeric_cols, gridExpand = TRUE)
 
 
 
# Alternating row shading by cluster group
groups <- cluster_export$Group
for (i in seq_len(n_cluster_rows)) {
  if (groups[i] %% 2 == 0)
    addStyle(wb, "Clusters", rows = i + 1, cols = 1:n_cluster_cols, gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE,
             style = createStyle(fgFill = "#EDE9F5", fontName = "Arial", fontSize = 10))
}
 
summary_start_col <- n_cluster_cols + 2
writeData(wb, "Clusters", cluster_summary, startRow = 1, startCol = summary_start_col,
          headerStyle = header_style, borders = "surrounding")
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Reference", cluster_colnames), widths = 25)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Group", cluster_colnames), widths = 10)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = numeric_cols, widths = 14)
if ("Representative" %in% cluster_colnames)
  setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Representative", cluster_colnames), widths = 14)
if ("Hit" %in% cluster_colnames)
  setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = match("Hit", cluster_colnames), widths = 10)
setColWidths(wb, "Clusters", cols = summary_start_col:(summary_start_col + 2), widths = c(10, 8, 40))
freezePane(wb, "Clusters", firstRow = TRUE)
 
# ── Save workbook ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(out_dir, "cheminformatics_results.xlsx"), overwrite = TRUE)
 
message("Export complete:")
message("  Images: tanimoto_heatmap.png, tanimoto_distribution.png, pca_scatter.png,")
message("umap_scatter.png, hits_structures.png, hits_structures_grouped.png")
message("  Excel:  cheminformatics_results.xlsx (3 sheets: Tanimoto Similarity, UMAP Results, Clusters)")

} else {
  message("Fewer than 2 compounds passed the cheminformatics filters (n_chem = ", n_chem,
          ") -- skipping heatmap/PCoA/UMAP/cluster image generation and cheminformatics_results.xlsx export.")
}
```
